name: Sausage and Cottage Cheese Egg Bake
why: Egg + cottage cheese + colby jack bound crustless bake; identity is the bake, sausage is a component. Published 445 cal / 30g protein / 8g carbs sits mid-band on calories, clears the 25g+ protein identity, and rock-bottom on carbs. No bread/potato/rice. Weigh-and-divide bake, scales cleanly to 14. colby-jack has no exact board home (maps to shredded/cheddar); avocado-oil swaps to vegetable-oil - flagged for the pricer lane.
